run_translation_generation: run the fairseq generate.py CLI to translate pre-processed data with a trained model
run_bleu_scoring: run the generate.py module to compute BLEU scores on translated output against target text
run_beam_search_inference: run beam search inference on a dataset using a loaded fairseq model ensemble
run_alignment_generation: run the generate.py module with --print-alignment to output source-target token alignments
run_prefix_constrained_generation: run generation with a prefix size to constrain output with prefix tokens from the target
